Package org.checkerframework.framework.testchecker.elementdefault

package org.checkerframework.framework.testchecker.elementdefault
  • Class
    Description
    ElementDefaultAnnotatedTypeFactory
    Calls QualifierDefaults.addElementDefault(javax.lang.model.element.Element, javax.lang.model.element.AnnotationMirror, org.checkerframework.framework.qual.TypeUseLocation) directly on package elementdefault.pkg and on two of its classes, and QualifierDefaults.addPackageDefault(javax.lang.model.element.PackageElement, javax.lang.model.element.AnnotationMirror, org.checkerframework.framework.qual.TypeUseLocation, boolean) on package elementdefault.nonpropagating, rather than through a written @DefaultQualifier annotation.
    ElementDefaultBottom
    The bottom qualifier of the trivial two-qualifier hierarchy used only by ElementDefaultChecker.
    ElementDefaultChecker
    A checker used only to test QualifierDefaults.addElementDefault(javax.lang.model.element.Element, javax.lang.model.element.AnnotationMirror, org.checkerframework.framework.qual.TypeUseLocation): its ElementDefaultAnnotatedTypeFactory calls that method directly, rather than through a written @DefaultQualifier annotation, on one package and two classes of framework/tests/elementdefault's test sources.
    ElementDefaultProgrammaticAllowedBottom
    A qualifier with restricted @TargetLocations, but with @ProgrammaticDefaultLocations allowing all locations for programmatic defaults.
    ElementDefaultRestrictedBottom
    A qualifier with restricted target locations used to test that defaults cannot be registered for locations prohibited by @TargetLocations.
    ElementDefaultTop
    The top qualifier of the trivial two-qualifier hierarchy used only by ElementDefaultChecker.
